# Soulcaster

> Runtime Hermetic Compiler Attestation & in-toto SLSA Level 3 Provenance.

## Core Capabilities
- Compiler Wrapping (`soulcaster wrap`): Wraps toolchains (`go build`, `cargo`, `clang`, `make`), capturing input source files, compiler binary digests, and output artifacts.
- TOCTOU Defense: Computes pre-build and post-build cryptographic snapshots of all source files to detect in-flight source swapping or tampering.
- Hermeticity Enforcement: Blocks external network egress (`GOPROXY=off`, `GOSUMDB=off`) during compilation.
- in-toto & SLSA v1.0 Compliant: Outputs verifiable attestation JSONL files (`<binary>.intoto.jsonl`).
- Attestation Verifier (`soulcaster verify`): Re-hashes binaries and verifies compliance against recorded attestations.

## CLI Usage
- `soulcaster wrap -o <output_binary> -- <compile_command>`: Compiles binary under hermetic attestation.
- `soulcaster verify --attestation <file.intoto.jsonl> <binary>`: Validates binary integrity against attestation.
